get_fused_adam_class: get the appropriate FusedAdam optimizer class by checking for apex fused_adam_cuda or multi_tensor_applier availability
create_FusedAdamV1_optimizer: create a FusedAdamV1 optimizer instance with custom learning rate, betas, and weight decay for GPU-only Adam training
run_FusedAdamV1_step: run a single optimization step on FusedAdamV1 with optional grads, scale factor, and gradient norms
create_FusedAdamV2_optimizer: create a FusedAdamV2 optimizer that extends apex FusedAdam with multi-tensor apply support for fp16 and fp32 params
run_FusedAdamV2_step: run a single optimization step on FusedAdamV2 using multi_tensor_applier for batched fp16 and fp32 parameter updates
